title: isolation.json
description: What a plugin in the Riff repository needs, beside its main file. docs/isolation.md explains each part; .github/scripts/isolation.js holds the code to it.

plugin.description: The plugin's slug, its folder's name.

namespace.description: An extension's own namespace under Riff\, the only one of Riff's it may name.

options.description: Prefixes of the options, site options and transients it owns.

meta.description: Prefixes of the post, user, term and comment meta keys it owns, user options included.

shared.description: WordPress's own keys it writes on purpose, each with why. Left on uninstall: they are WordPress's.

keep.description: Keys under its prefixes that uninstall leaves, each with why.

namespaces.description: The REST namespaces it registers routes under.

fields.description: The fields it adds to WordPress's routes, as object.field.

public.description: Routes anyone may write to, as namespace/route, each with why and what limits it.

hosts.description: The hosts it may call: a name, *.name for it and every host under it, or self for the site's own.

spawn.description: The programs it runs, if any.

cron.description: The cron events it schedules, each with why.

paths.description: Folders outside uploads and the temp folder it may write to, each by the constant or filter a site names it with, and why.

riff.description: An extension's use of Riff: only what docs/hooks.md, docs/javascript.md and src/functions.php make public.

hooks.description: Riff's PHP actions and filters it hooks.

events.description: The player's JavaScript actions and filters it hears, without riff.

scripts.description: The classic script handles it registers.

modules.description: The script module ids it registers.

sandbox.description: Experimental, for an extension run in the php-wasm sandbox (docs/isolation.md): what the bridge lets it read, the events it runs on, and its limits.
